 Amazon Music Tapped to Livestream Tyler, the Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival 2026
 Ashley King November 8, 2026 Photo Credit: Amazon Music
 Tyler, the Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival returns to Amazon Music for the fourth consecutive year of their exclusive livestreaming partnership.
 Last week, Amazon Music announced that it will exclusively livestream Tyler, the Creator’s 12th annual Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival , taking place on November 14 and 15 on the Dodger Stadium grounds in Los Angeles. The 2026 edition sold out immediately and features a lineup of 40-plus artists spanning hip-hop, R&B, rock, and more.
 For the fourth consecutive year, Amazon Music will bring Camp Flog Gnaw to fans around the world, exclusively livestreaming the carnival on the Amazon Music app, Twitch, Prime Video, and Amazon Live. Hosts Wayno and Jullian Superstar will take viewers behind the scenes with artist interviews and live coverage from the festival, offering an inside look at the weekend’s events. The livestream is sponsored by Lenovo and Wendy’s.
 Fans worldwide can also catch the performances through a daily international rebroadcast beginning at 8 AM GMT on November 15 and 16, giving viewers more ways to experience the carnival across timezones. Ahead of the weekend, fans can get ready for the festival with the Official Camp Flog Gnaw Playlist on Amazon Music, featuring music from this year’s performing artists.
 Tyler, the Creator’s Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival celebrated its 11th edition in 2025, solidifying the event as one of the premier music festivals and one of the most sought-after artist-led festivals on the calendar. Produced in collaboration with Goldenvoice, the festival has spotlighted unforgettable performances in the arc of many artists’ careers, including Childish Gambino, The Hillbillies, SZA, A$AP Rocky, Solange, Doechii, KAYTRANADA, Lil Yachty, GloRilla, Billie Eilish, Erykah Badu, Andre 3000, Lauryn Hill, and many others.
 This year’s lineup includes Steve Lacy, Turnstile, Future, Don Toliver, JID, Lupe Fiasco, Vince Staples, Wallows, Syd, and Isaiah Rashad. Tyler, the Creator himself, is also scheduled to perform. Other performers include Lola Young Quadeca, 2hollis, Concrete Boys, Earl Sweatshier & MIKE, Domo Genesis, The Alchemist, Leon Thomas, Magdalena Bay, Jane Remover, Thee Sacred Souls, Audrey Nuna, Latin Mafia, Casey Veggies, and 310babii. The festival will also include sets from Gabriel Jacoby, Natanya, Threetwenty, Left Brain, Liim, Mike G, NSQK, Nomi, GENA, Wyatt Waddell, Ama, Not For Radio, and 54 Ultra.
